career_ladder.note: Technician 'A' (Tech-A) is the skilled technical workshop cadre of DRDO holding Class 10 qualification plus ITI certification in designated engineering trades. Technicians operate high-precision machine tools, electronic fabrication assemblies, prototyping workshops, and instrumentation facilities across defence labs. Promotions follow the DRTC flexible complementing framework.

exam_scheme.note: Selection to Technician 'A' comprises a two-tier process: Tier-I CBT for Provisional Selection consisting of quantitative aptitude, general intelligence, awareness, English, and trade-specific questions; and Tier-II Trade Test (practical skill test in the relevant trade) which is qualifying in nature. Merit is compiled strictly from Tier-I scores of candidates who qualify Tier-II.

stages.stage_name: Tier-I: Computer Based Test (CBT) for Provisional Selection
stages.source_label: DRDO CEPTAM-10/DRTC — Scheme of Examination for Tech-A

papers.paper_name: Section A (Common Aptitude): Quantitative Ability/Aptitude, General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Awareness, English Language (40 Questions)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Combined with Section B; Minimum 40% for UR/OBC/EWS and 35% for SC/ST

papers.paper_name: Section B (Trade Specific): Questions specific to candidate's ITI Trade syllabus (80 Questions)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Tier-I total marks (120) determine 100% of provisional selection merit

stages.source_label: DRDO CEPTAM-10/DRTC — Scheme of Tier-II Trade Test for Tech-A

papers.paper_name: Practical Trade Skill Test: Hands-on evaluation in DRDO laboratory workshops on ITI machines and trade instruments
papers.qualifying_threshold: Strictly qualifying in nature; 1:8 shortlisting ratio based on Tier-I CBT score

financial_package.note: Technician 'A' in DRDO is placed in Pay Matrix Level 2 (₹19,900 – ₹63,200) under the 7th CPC. Employees receive central DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, CGHS medical coverage, and uniform maintenance allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: DRDO CEPTAM-10/DRTC Advertisement — Pay Matrix Level 2 for Tech-A
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 2 entry basic pay of ₹19,900: Dearness Allowance @ 58% is ₹11,542; HRA ranges from 10% (₹1,990 in Z class) to 30% (₹5,970 in X class); Transport Allowance is ₹1,350 + DA (₹2,133) in standard research cities. Gross monthly earnings range from ₹36,000 to ₹44,000. In-hand earnings after 10% NPS deduction (₹3,144) are approximately ₹31,000 to ₹38,000.
official_perks: CGHS or DRDO Laboratory Medical dispensary facilities for self and dependent family members
Government residential quarter allotment in DRDO housing complexes or central HRA
Children Education Allowance (CEA) of ₹2,250 per month per child
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% monthly employer contribution by Government of India
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and annual leave encashment
CSD Canteen card privileges for civilian defence employees
